POWER PLAN GENERAL NOTES:
1. UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED, ALL CONDUIT IS INTENDED TO BE ROUTED
CONCEALED. PATCH/ PAINT WALLS AS NECESSARY.
2. ALLOW FOR UP TO TWO TANDEM CIRCUIT BREAKERS PER MDF OR IDF
ROOM TO FREE SPACE ON EXISTING EMERGENCY PANELS.
3. REFER TO MECHANICAL DEMOLITION DRAWINGS FOR HVAC EQUIPMENT
TO BE DEMOLISHED. COORDINATE ELECTRICAL REMOVAL OF
CONDUIT/WIRE/DISCONNECTS TO SOURCE.
4. PROVIDE (14) 2X4 LIGHTING FIXTURES, LOCATIONS TO BE PROVIDED
DURING CONSTRUCTION. PROVIDE RECESSED LED 2X4 FLAT PANEL -
DAYBRITE #2FPZ48L840-4-DS-UNV-DIM
5. CONTRACTOR SHALL ENSURE PANEL SCHEDULE DIRECTORY IS UPDATED
FOR NEW OR REMOVED CIRCUITS WITH LOAD NAMES PROPERLY
IDENTIFIED AT THE ASSOCIATED PANEL.
6. ALL 4 FT LINEAR STRIP LIGHTING FIXTURES SHOWN SHALL BE NEW
DAYBRITE #FLP445L840-LUNV-DIM UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
7. ALL CONDUIT IN SHEETROCK WALLS SHALL BE INSTALLED INSIDE THE
WALL, NOT EXTERNALLY (UNLESS IT IS CMU).
8. ALL NEW L5-20R AND L6-30R RECEPTACLES SHALL BE MOUNTED TO THE
CABLE TRAY, FACING THE BACK OF THE RACK.
POWER PLAN KEYED NOTES:
1 PROVIDE DISCONNECT WITH WEATHERPROOF GFCI RECEPTACLE.
RECEPTACLE CIRCUIT SHALL NOT BE CONNECTED THRU DISCONNECT.
REFER TO DETAIL ON DRAWING SHEET #1/E-000 FOR ADDITIONAL
REQUIREMENTS.
2 PROVIDE NEW CIRCUIT FROM EXISTING EMERGENCY PANELBOARD.
PANELBOARD LOCATED AS SHOWN ON POWER FLOOR PLANS. PROVIDE
20A/2P BREAKER IN SPACE OF EXISTING PANELBOARD. WIRE AND
CONNECT CIRCUIT THRU CONDENSING UNIT TO FAN COIL UNIT.
3 APPROXIMATE LOCATION OF EXISTING EMERGENCY PANELBOARD,
OPTIONAL STANDBY PANELBOARD, OR NORMAL POWER PANELBOARD.
4 PROVIDE LABOR AND MATERIALS TO ADJUST THE LOCATION OF THE
EXISTING RECEPTACLE(S) TO ACCOMMODATE THE NEW RACK
LOCATION. ALLOW FOR NEW RECEPTACLE, BACKBOX, CONDUIT AND
EXTENSION OF WIRE. WALL MOUNTED RACK IS TO BE REPLACED WITH
FLOOR MOUNTED RACK.
5 CONNECT VIA 2#12, 1#12G, 3/4"C. CONNECT TO NEARBY GENERAL
RECEPTACLE CIRCUIT. UPDATE PANEL SCHEDULE TO REFLECT ADDED
LOAD.
6 MOUNT ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT/DEVICES ON HIGH/LOW ROOF
TRANSITION.
7 PROVIDE 20A/120V CIRCUIT FOR CONDENSATE PUMP SERVING HVAC
UNIT. CONNECT TO PANELBOARD ALSO SERVING HVAC UNIT. PROVIDE
MOTOR RATED SWITCH FOR LOCAL DISCONNECTING MEANS. CONNECT
VIA 2#12, 1#12, 3/4"C. PROVIDE 20A/1P BREAKER IN SPACE OF PANEL
NOTED.
8 PROVIDE NEW CIRCUIT FROM EXISTING EMERGENCY PANELBOARD.
PANELBOARD LOCATED AS SHOWN ON POWER FLOOR PLANS. PROVIDE
35A/2P BREAKER IN SPACE OF EXISTING PANELBOARD. WIRE AND
CONNECT CIRCUIT THRU CONDENSING UNIT TO FAN COIL UNIT.
9 EXISTING GROUND BAR, RECEPTACLE AND LIGHT SWITCH TO BE
RELOCATED. EXTEND EXISTING CONDUIT AND WIRE TO NEW LOCATION
SHOWN, MATCH EXISTING SIZES.
10 EXISTING OUTLET AT GOGGLE STORAGE CABINET TO BE RELOCATED.
EXTEND EXISTING CIRCUIT, MOUNT WITHIN WALL. VERIFY EXACT NEW
LOCATION WITH OWNER PRIOR TO INSTALLATION.
11 EXISTING 2X4 LIGHTING FIXTURE TO BE RELOCATED. DISCONNECT AND
RE-CONNECT TO EXISTING LIGHTING CIRCUIT IN THIS ROOM.
12 PROVIDE NEW LIGHTING FIXTURES AND CONTROLS IN THIS ROOM.
CONNECT LIGHTING FIXTURES TO EXISTING LOCAL 277V LIGHTING
CIRCUIT. CONNECT EXISTING EMERGENCY CIRCUIT TO GTD.
13 PROVIDE NEW GENERAL PURPOSE RECEPTACLE. WIRE AND CONNECT
TO LOCAL 120V/20A EMERGENCY POWER CIRCUIT. CONNECT TO
CIRCUIT NOTED AT KEYED NOTE #7.
14 INDOOR FAN COIL UNIT (FCU) IS POWERED BY EXTERIOR AIR-COOLED
CONDENSER UNIT (ACCU). WIRE AND CONNECT CIRCUIT (CIRCUIT
PANEL AND NUMBER IS LISTED AT ACCU) FROM ACCU DOWN TO FCU.
15 DEMOLISH POWER INCLUDING WIRE, CONDUIT, AND DISCONNECT TO
EXISTING FCU. REMOVE WIRE/CONDUIT BACK TO SOURCE PANEL AND
MARK BREAKER AS 'SPARE'.
16 DEMOLISH CIRCUIT TO EXISTING IDF CABINET INCLUDING WIRE AND
CONDUIT. REMOVE WIRE/CONDUIT BACK TO SOURCE PANEL AND MARK
BREAKER AS 'SPARE'.
17 DEMOLISH POWER INCLUDING WIRE, CONDUIT, AND DISCONNECT TO
EXISTING FLOOR AND PLENUM MOUNTED UNITS. REMOVE
WIRE/CONDUIT BACK TO SOURCE PANEL AND MARK BREAKER AS
'SPARE'.

TECHNOLOGY PLAN GENERAL NOTES
A. CAMERA ORIENTATION SHOWN DOES NOT INDICATE ACTUAL FIELD OF
VIEW. COORDINATE WITH OWNER AND ADJUST CAMERAS FOR PROPER
FIELD OF VIEW.
B. CONTRACTOR SHALL TEST EACH EXISTING DIVISION 27 AND 28 SYSTEM
PRIOR TO THE START OF CONSTRUCTION FOR THE FUNCTIONALITY OF
ALL DEVICES AND CONNECTED CABLING. CONTRACTOR SHALL
GENERATE A LIST OF FAULTY EQUIPMENT AND PROVIDE TO THE
ARCHITECT. ANY EXISTING TO REMAIN DEVICE OR CABLING FOUND TO
BE FAULTY UPON PROJECT COMPLETION SHALL BE REPLACED AND/OR
REPAIRED BY THE CONTRACTOR AT NO ADDITIONAL COST TO THE
PROJECT OR THE OWNER.
C. CONTRACTOR SHALL DOCUMENT THE LOCATION AND ANY ID TAG, MAC
ADDRESS, IP ADDRESS OR BAR CODE OF ANY EXISTING DEVICE THAT
IS TO BE REMOVED FROM ITS CURRENT LOCATION. DEVICES THAT ARE
TO REMAIN SHALL BE REINSTALLED IN THE EXACT LOCATION THAT
THEY RESIDE PRIOR TO CONSTRUCTION, UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
D. ANY INDIVIDUAL/FIRM THAT WILL BE REMOVING, RELOCATING OR
REINSTALLING DIVISION 27 AND 28 DEVICES SHALL BE CERTIFIED BY
THE MANUFACTURER OF THE SYSTEM.
E. NOT ALL EXISTING DEVICES ARE SHOWN ON DRAWINGS. DEVICE
LOCATIONS ARE APPROXIMATE. CONTRACTOR IS RESPONSIBLE FOR
FIELD VERIFICATION.
F. COORDINATE WITH CCISD PRIOR TO THE MOUNTING OR INSTALLATION
OF ANY EQUIPMENT RACKS. VERIFY FINAL RACK LOCATIONS AND
MOUNTING REQUIREMENTS WITH CCISD BEFORE PROCEEDING WITH
INSTALLATION.
KEYNOTES
TN-1 EXISTING TELECOMMUNICATIONS EQUIPMENT RACK, CABINET, OR
ENCLOSURE TO REMAIN. PROTECT EXISTING EQUIPMENT, CABLING,
AND ASSOCIATED COMPONENTS DURING CONSTRUCTION.
TN-9 INDICATES EXISTING WALL-MOUNTED CABINET TO BE DEMOLISHED
AND REPLACED WITH (QTY. 2) NEW 52RU (MINIMUM 96-INCH)
FLOOR-MOUNTED TWO-POST EQUIPMENT RACK. PROVIDE VERTICAL
CABLE MANAGEMENTS ON BOTH SIDES, HORIZONTAL CABLE
MANAGEMENT, GROUNDING, BRACING, AND ALL REQUIRED
ACCESSORIES FOR A COMPLETE AND FULLY FUNCTIONAL
INSTALLATION. PROVIDE LABOR AND MATERIALS TO REMOVE ALL
EXISTING COMPONENTS FROM WALL MOUNTED RACKS AND
RE-INSTALL IN NEW RACK. ALL CABLES THAT ARE DISCONNECTED
(OTHER THAN SIMPLY UNPLUGGED) SHALL BE TESTED.

1. ALLOW FOR UP TO A 15' SHIFT FOR BOTH THE LOCATION OF THE CONDENSING
UNIT AND DUCTLESS UNIT TO ALLOW FOR OBSTRUCTIONS IN THE IMMEDIATE
VICINITY OF LOCATION SHOWN. EXTEND LINE SETS AS NECESSARY.
2. ALLOW FOR THE RELOCATION OF ONE SPRINKLER HEAD PER MDF AND IDF
SPACE RECEIVING A NEW HVAC UNIT TO AVOID CONFLICT WITH NEW DUCTLESS
UNIT. RELOCATION SHALL BE PERFORMED BY A LICENSED FIRE SPRINKLER
CONTRACTOR.
3. IN GENERAL, DEMOLITION OF EXISTING HVAC UNITS AND EXHAUST FANS SHALL
INCLUDE INDOOR, OUTDOOR AND/OR CEILING MOUNTED UNITS, THEIR
SUPPORTS, CONDENSATE LINES, THERMOSTATS, CABLING, CONNECTION TO BAS
(INCLUDING PROGRAMMING TO REMOVE), ELECTRICAL SERVICE, AND
DUCTWORK/ GRILLES. CEILING TILES SHALL BE REPLACED MATCHING THE
EXISTING SIZE AND FIRE RATING (IF ANY). ROOF PENETRATIONS SHALL BE
CAPPED, ROOF CURBS SHALL REMAIN. FURTHER DETAILS NOTED ON PLANS.
4. CONDENSATE DRAINS SHOWN TO ROUTE TO MOP SINKS SHALL BE ROUTED TO
ADJACENT FLOOR DRAINS IF PRESENT.

CORRESPONDING POINT FROM BAS.

PROVIDE OPENING IN GRATING SUCH THAT DRAINAGE IS NOT BLOCKED.

AND THERMOSTATS TO CCISD MAINTENANCE DEPT AND REMOVE DATA DROPS

LOCATED WITHIN WALLS.

WRAPPED WITH ALUMINUM JACKETING.
